description: Browse the global catalog of indexed public repositories (across all Code-Fundi users). Supports pagination, an `updated_since` cursor, and optional embedding of each repo's largest files. This endpoint does not require an API key.

file_count.description: When > 0, embed this many largest files per repo (default 0)

internal_secret.description: Internal sitemap secret for unlimited server-side enumeration (optional)

since.description: Return repos updated strictly after this ISO 8601 timestamp

name: code-fundi-list-public-repos
